name: Saeko
source: Kenji's sponsor who gives him work. Editor of an SM-focused magazine. She's lecherous, violent, cold-hearted, and a schemer, but caring when it comes to her family. The person who introduced Kenji to the boarding house. She was Sayoko's senpai.
